newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse falls in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse falls in thin trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index dipped further on Friday weighed down by Super Products Paper Company, which fell two to 108 cedis.
The Ghana All-Share index edged 0.03 points down to 362.79 from 362.82 on Wednesday.
Other shares held their previous values.
Trade was thin as 9,940 shares changed hands compared to 39,620 on Wednesday. Bids continued to outpace offers by 528,840 to 3,801,420.
